description: Presidential Secretariat - Duties & Functions of Ministers
reasoning: This gazette notification names President Maithripala Sirisena and provides detailed assignment of ministerial portfolios, subjects, functions, departments, public corporations, and statutory institutions to various ministers. It contains both the "who" (the President making the assignments) and extensive "what" (detailed responsibilities and institutional oversight for each ministry), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
